    Html.element(
        "div",
        [
            Html.attribute("class", "box"),
            Html.attribute("title", title),
        ],
        [
            content,
        ],
    )
}


compat = |{ title, active, items }| {
    Html.element(
        "section",
        [
            Html.attribute("title", title),
        ],
        [
            Html.element(
                "h1",
                [],
                [
                    Html.text(title),
                ],
            ),
            if active {
                Html.element(
                    "b",
                    [],
                    [
                        Html.text("active"),
                    ],
                )
            } else {
                Html.empty
            },
            Html.void_element(
                "img",
                [
                    Html.attribute("src", "x"),
                    Html.attribute("alt", title),
                ],
            ),
            Html.void_element(
                "br",
                [],
            ),
            Html.void_element(
                "input",
                [
                    Html.boolean_attribute("disabled", True),
                ],
            ),
            Html.element(
                "ul",
                [],
                List.map(items, |item| {
                    Html.element(
                        "li",
                        [
                            Html.attribute("title", item.name),
                        ],
                        List.concat(
                            [
                                inner(
                                    { name: item.name },
                                ),
                            ],
                            List.map(item.kids, |kid| {
                                Html.element(
                                    "i",
                                    [],
                                    [
                                        Html.text(kid.name),
                                    ],
                                )
                            }),
                        ),
                    )
                }),
            ),
            box(
                { title: title },
                Html.element(
                    "span",
                    [],
                    [
                        Html.text(title),
                    ],
                ),
            ),
        ],
    )
}
